title: Affine sections identify a quasi-coherent module completion with its adic completion
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme, $J$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaf data, and $H$ a quasi-coherent module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, pqf-def-coherent]. Let $U$ be affine and put $R=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $I=J(U)$, and $M=\Gamma(U,H)$. Write $S_n=H/J^{n+1}H$ with its canonical reductions, and let $E$ be evaluation on $U$. There exist $R$-module isomorphisms $q_n:M/I^{n+1}M\cong E(S_n)$ such that $q_n\circ\mathrm{mkQ}=E(\pi_n)$, and an isomorphism $e:\widehat M\cong E(\lim S)$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] such that $E(\mathrm{pr}_n)\circ e=q_n\circ\operatorname{eval}_{n+1}$. No Noetherian or finiteness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Schemes, Tags 01I8 and 01IC (schemes.tex); Lemma 088B, affine calculation; Theorem 02OC, quotient inverse-limit argument

proof.text: The powered ideal inclusion is quasi-coherent and has affine range I^(n+1). Apply the proved multiplication_range and product_qc helpers of the ideal-times module through import all to identify the range of its product inclusion as I^(n+1)M.

Apply quasiCoherent_cokernel_image to this product inclusion: the actual quotient projection is surjective and has kernel I^(n+1)M. Submodule.quotEquivOfEq followed by quotKerEquivOfSurjective gives q_n, with the quotient projection equation by evaluation on representatives.

The cokernel-desc equation for formalModuleQuotientMap makes rho_n compatible with transitions. Cancel mkQ to prove transition compatibility of theta_n=q_n. Each theta_n is injective, so ker rho_n is contained in I^(n+1)M; each rho_n is surjective, so its range is all of E(S_n), equal to the range of the identity transition for c=0.

Apply adicCompletion_iso_of_stable_ranges with c=0 to obtain an isomorphism from the completion to limit(S composed with E). Compose with the inverse of preservesLimitIso E S; preservesLimitIso_inv_pi and the supplied projection equations give exactly the asserted e equations.

lean.statement: theorem formalCompletion_affine_sections {Y : Scheme.{u}} (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (H : Y.Modules) [H.IsQuasicoherent] (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) : let R := Γ(Y, U) let I := J.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ let M := Γ(H, U) let S := formalCompletionSystem J H let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U) ∃ q : ∀ n : ℕ, ModuleCat.of R (M ⧸ (I ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M))) ≅ E.obj (S.obj (op n)), (∀ n : ℕ, ModuleCat.ofHom (Submodule.mkQ (I ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M))) ≫ (q n).hom = E.map (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) H)) ∧ ∃ e : ModuleCat.of R (AdicCompletion I M) ≅ E.obj (limit S), ∀ n : ℕ, e.hom ≫ E.map (limit.π S (op n)) = ModuleCat.ofHom (AdicCompletion.eval I M (n + 1)) ≫ (q n).hom
